title: Compatible flat coefficient input and its module diagram functors
statement: Let $\mathcal C_V,\mathcal C_U$ be small sites in the module-sheaf universe and let $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ be a geometric adjunction, with $u^{-1}$ preserving finite limits [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Let $R_V,S_V$ and $R_U,S_U$ be sheaves of commutative rings, with maps $a_V:R_V\to S_V$ and $a_U:R_U\to S_U$ and with $S_T$ flat over $R_T$ for $T=U,V$ [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. A flat ringed diagram input records the two induced module direct images, the algebraic inverse images along $u^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], their ring isomorphisms $c_B:u^{-1}B_V\simeq B_U$ for $B=R,S$, and the equation $a_Uc_R=c_Su^{-1}a_V$. It records the induced additive module adjunctions $L_B\dashv F_B$, whose underlying Hom bijections are the given sheaf adjunction under the specified underlying-sheaf identifications [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For any small category $J$, put $\mathcal A_{T,B}=\operatorname{Fun}(J,\operatorname{Mod}(B_T))$ and define $r_T$, $L_B$, $F_B$ by termwise restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], inverse image and direct image. Abbreviate their degreewise functors on integer cochain complexes and the localizations $D(\mathcal A_{T,B})$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For ordinary isomorphisms $b^0:r_UL_S\simeq L_Rr_V$ and $d^0:r_VF_S\simeq F_Rr_U$, the ordinary normalization predicate means that at every $J$-index their underlying maps are the identities between the specified inverse-image and direct-image sheaves, using those identifications.
